title: Car Brands: Consumer Reports 2026 Overall Rankings
desc: Consumer Reports’ 2026 overall brand order combines road-test performance, predicted reliability, owner satisfaction and safety. This is a U.S.-market brand-level comparison, not a universal measure; model and market differences matter.

source.name: Consumer Reports — 2026 Overall Automotive Brand Report Card
source.note: All five brand names, order, and ranking context were checked against Consumer Reports’ 2026 report and official press release by AllRanks on 2026-10-20. Brand order is based on road-test performance, predicted reliability, owner satisfaction, and safety; it is not a model-specific buying recommendation.

items.name: BMW
items.detail: Runner-up, less than one point behind Subaru
